newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Equatorial appoints MIM executive as ceo.
newsitem.headline: Equatorial appoints MIM executive as ceo.

text.p: Equatorial Mining Ltd said on Wednesday that it planned to appoint Bernard Holtshousen as chief executive to replace Peter McAleer.
Holtshousen is currently the executive general manager - gold at mining house MIM Holdings Ltd.
Equatorial said McAleer had wanted to step down as chief executive but would retain an executive position focussed on the firm's operations in Latin America.
It said Holtshousen had held senior positions with South Africa's Gencor Ltd, Rand London Corp Ltd and Phelps Dodge Ltd in South Africa.

Australian insurance and funds management group, The Austalian Mutual Provident Society, is the largest shareholder in Equatorial with an 81.75 percent stake, with most of the shares received following a hostile bid earlier this year.
Equatorial has a stake in Chile's el Tesoro copper mine which is set to begin production late next year.
